description: Ordinary updates must not trigger a release. They only rewrite uv.lock,
which reaches neither the PyPI artifact (whose metadata is the open >=
ranges) nor the Homebrew formula (whose resource blocks come from the pip
config:recommended, which would label pep621 project dependencies as
fix(deps) and so cut a release for a bit-identical build.

packageRules.description: Keep workflow-action churn to a single PR.

description: video/ is the Remotion project behind the README demo. CI does not build
it, so a green run says nothing about whether these updates work.
Renovate still opens the PRs, because the security value is real, but a
human has to look before merging. Revisit if CI ever builds the video.
The only path on which a dependency update releases. rangeStrategy 'bump'
raises the lower bound in pyproject.toml, so the published metadata really
changes, and the fix type makes python-semantic-release cut a patch.
Renovate applies this on top of packageRules, so the chore override above
